jobs.title: Technology Operations Engineer I (Junior System Administrator)
jobs.description:
**Technology Operations Engineer I | Makati, Philippines**

Pax8 is hiring a **Technology Operations Engineer I in Makati, Philippines** , to keep our global technology environment running smoothly by solving technical issues, supporting critical systems, and delivering a consistently great technology experience.

**Salary & Benefits**

**Salary: PHP 65,000 - 75,000**

* **20 Annual Leaves (accruing monthly)**
* **Pax8 offers an additional 10 days of bonus leave every year! AND YES, the 10 days are available from your first day!**
* **In addition to the above, we offer all our employees Private Health Insurance. Beneficial for when life happens!**
* **Unlimited growth through our learning & development (L&D) programs in an environment that fosters internal promotions, helping you gain the necessary skills to reach the next step in your professional journey!**
* **Connecting with our community is important – which is why we have our donation matching program, DEI-B events, and our employee resource groups to ensure everyone feels at home at Pax8.**

**Your Makati Working Environment**

**Working pattern:** Onsite for the first 6 months, transitioning to a hybrid setup thereafter.

**Shift:** Night shift, with the possibility of rotating shifts including weekends.

**Build Your Technology Career at Pax8**

This is an opportunity to build broad, hands-on experience across modern workplace technologies while being part of Pax8’s **Global Technology Operations** team.

You’ll work across Microsoft cloud services, identity and access, endpoint management, enterprise platforms, incident management, and operational support. As Pax8 continues to evolve alongside **AI-powered technology and automation** , you’ll have the opportunity to grow with new tools, develop your technical judgement, and see how a global technology organization operates at scale.

You'll be trusted to solve problems independently while having experienced teammates around you when an issue needs deeper expertise.

**Technology, People & Culture**

At Pax8, technology is at the center of what we do, but our people are what make it work. We value curiosity, knowledge sharing, collaboration, and people who enjoy figuring things out rather than simply following a script.

Get to know more about Pax8 and explore the technology behind our Pax8 Marketplace .

**️ What You’ll Be Doing**

As a Technology Operations Engineer I, you’ll help keep Pax8 people productive and our technology services reliable.

Your day-to-day will include:

* **Solve technology problems** across laptops, software, business applications, connectivity, Microsoft services, and enterprise platforms.
* **Respond to incidents** by identifying impact and urgency, troubleshooting effectively, and escalating more complex issues to the right engineering teams.
* **Support identity and access** through Microsoft Entra ID, including common account, password, licensing, and access requests.
* **Support employee devices** through Microsoft Intune, helping with enrolment, compliance, application deployment, and everyday endpoint issues.
* + ️ **Work across Microsoft 365** , including Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Exchange Online.
* + ️ **Help maintain our platforms** , supporting approved updates, patching, backups, monitoring, configuration, and routine maintenance.
* **Own and progress support tickets** using platforms such as ServiceNow and Jira, keeping people informed from initial issue through resolution.
* **Improve how we work** by identifying repetitive tasks, supporting automation, and helping make technology workflows simpler and more reliable.
* **Turn troubleshooting into shared knowledge** by creating useful documentation, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.
* **Learn from incidents** by contributing to post-incident reviews and helping the team prevent recurring problems.

**The Impact You’ll Make**

Your work will directly influence how reliably Pax8 teams can work every day. By resolving issues quickly, keeping systems healthy, and turning what you learn into better processes and documentation, you’ll help reduce disruption and create a smoother technology experience across the organization.

You won't just close tickets. You'll help build a more reliable and scalable Technology Operations environment.

**You’ll Be a Great Fit If You Have**

* Reasonable hands-on experience in **information technology support, service desk, technical operations, or a similar environment**
* Practical experience troubleshooting common hardware, software, application, and connectivity issues
* Familiarity with **Microsoft Entra ID** and common identity and access requests
* Experience using **Microsoft Intune** for endpoint support, device compliance, enrolment, or application deployment
* Working knowledge of **Microsoft 365** , particularly Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Exchange Online
* Experience working with ticketing or service management platforms such as **ServiceNow or Jira**
* A structured approach to troubleshooting and the judgement to know when an issue needs escalation
* An appreciation of security fundamentals, including multi-factor authentication and endpoint protection
* The ability to explain technical issues clearly to people with different levels of technical knowledge
Comfort working in a fast-moving operations environment where priorities can change

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer - Network Specialist
jobs.description:
The Infrastructure Engineer is a technical execution role responsible for the installation, configuration, and maintenance of the organization's server landscape, with a strong focus on Linux operating systems and cloud environments. This individual ensures high system availability, manages rigorous patch cycles, executes robust backup strategies, and resolves technical incidents to minimize downtime. The role plays a vital part in maintaining the stability of both on-premise and cloud infrastructure to support continuous business operations.

Key Result Areas:

* System Uptime & Server Maintenance
* Incident Resolution (MTTR)
* Cloud Infrastructure Management
* Service Delivery (Installation, Configuration, Patching)
* Backup & Disaster Recovery
* Sustainable IT Operations

Key Responsibilities:

* Maintain high availability and uptime for servers and mission-critical services, ensuring systems operate reliably to support business functions.
* Install, configure, and maintain server infrastructure, with a specific focus on managing and optimizing Linux operating systems.
* Analyze and resolve technical problems associated with server hardware, operating systems, and applications to ensure Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR) targets are met.
* Support the migration of on-premise servers to cloud environments and manage cloud infrastructure to ensure maximum stability and scalability.
* Execute the creation, configuration, and administration of new servers to fulfill business requirements efficiently.
* Implement strict patch management protocols to ensure all servers are up-to-date and secure against vulnerabilities.
* Manage backup operations to achieve high success rates and ensure Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) are strictly met during disaster recovery tests or actual incidents.
* Proactively identify and implement process improvements or projects that significantly enhance the efficiency and sustainability of IT operations.

Key Requirements:

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* At least 3-5 years of experience in Infrastructure Engineering, System Administration, or Server Management.
* Strong proficiency in Linux Operating Systems (installation, configuration, troubleshooting) is essential.
* Experience with Cloud Infrastructure and Virtualization technologies.
* Good problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve incidents within Service Level Agreements (SLA).

Benefits:

* Company Christmas gift
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Opportunities for promotion
* Promotion to permanent employee

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description:
Network Engineer

Your potential has a place here with TTEC’s award-winning employment experience. As a **Network Engineer** working hybrid within Araneta, Cubao Quezon City ,Philippines, you’ll be a part of bringing humanity to business. #experienceTTEC  
Our employees have spoken. Our purpose, team, and company culture are amazing and our Great Place to Work® certification in The Philippines says it all!

**What You’ll Do**

TTEC is seeking a Network & Firewall Engineer (P2) to join the IT Infrastructure Team, helping keep our global network and firewall environment stable, secure, and available around the clock. We’re a global company that is 46,000+ employees strong. Together, we are transforming the world of customer experience by helping our clients design and deliver simpler, more effective, efficient, and human customer service experiences that inspire customer loyalty and boost company profits. Our global IT organization of 600 supports the entire enterprise that encompasses over 40,000 users across our businesses aligned in four pillars - Customer Care, Technology Services, Strategy Services, & Growth Services. As part of this team, you will monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot the network and firewall services these users and businesses depend on every day.

**Key Responsibilities**  

* Monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot network and firewall related issues, including Cisco routing and switching, BGP, MPLS, and SD-WAN, plus data center and dark fiber connectivity (including Cisco ACI)
* Maintain and support Cisco Catalyst Center, Meraki, F5 (GTM, APM), and Infoblox; monitor with NetMRI, ManageEngine, ThousandEyes, Statseeker, and NETSCOUT
* Monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot Palo Alto firewalls (5200 series, Panorama, Prisma), firewall policies, and IPSec VPN
* Maintain and troubleshoot network access control (Cisco ISE, Aruba ClearPass) and DDoS protection (Cloudflare)
* Respond to security alerts and incidents, perform root cause analysis, and document all work in the ticketing system
* Liaise with vendors, escalate tickets, and support NOC and Helpdesk on complex network and firewall issues
* Support and troubleshoot cloud connectivity (GCP, Azure, AWS); basic automation with Python and Ansible is a plus
* Ability to work days, evenings, and weekends as required, including on-call support

**Required Skills**  

* Strong hands-on experience monitoring and troubleshooting Cisco routing and switching, BGP, and MPLS
* Working experience maintaining and troubleshooting Palo Alto firewalls and Panorama, IPSec VPN, and network security best practices
* Experience with SD-WAN and network monitoring tools
* Strong communication, documentation, and time management skills

**Preferred Skills**  

* Cisco ACI, ISE/NAC, and Meraki; F5 and Infoblox; Palo Alto Prisma
* Certifications such as CCNA, CCNP is a plus.

**Requirements**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field,

or equivalent practical experience
  

* 3-5 years of experience in network and firewall operations and support

**About TTEC**

Our business is about making customers happy. That's all we do. Since 1982, we've helped companies build engaged, pleased, profitable customer experiences powered by our combination of humanity and technology. On behalf of many of the world's leading iconic and hypergrowth brands, we talk, message, text, and video chat with millions of customers every day. These exceptional customer experiences start with you.

TTEC is proud to be an equal opportunity employer where all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. TTEC embraces and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce that respects and empowers the cultures and perspectives within our global teams. We aim to reflect the communities we serve, by not only delivering amazing service and technology, but also humanity. We make it a point to make sure all our employees feel valued, belonging, and comfortable being their authentic selves at work. As a global company, we know diversity is our strength because it enables us to view things from different vantage points and for you to bring value to the table in your own unique way.

jobs.title: AWS DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced AWS DevOps Engineer to join our talent pipeline for upcoming client engagements. You will design, automate, and maintain secure, highly available cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines, collaborating closely with software engineering teams to streamline deployments, optimize cloud costs, and ensure system reliability across production environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect, provision, and manage scalable AWS cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (**Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or AWS CDK**).
* Design, build, and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines (**GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or AWS CodePipeline**) for seamless application testing and deployment.
* Manage containerized workloads and orchestration using **Docker, Amazon ECS, and Amazon EKS (Kubernetes)**.
* Configure and maintain core AWS services including **EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, ElastiCache, Lambda, CloudFront, Route 53, and ALB/NLB**.
* Implement centralized logging, monitoring, and alerting solutions using **CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or ELK Stack** to ensure high availability and rapid incident response.
* Enforce cloud security best practices, IAM least-privilege policies, secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager / Parameter Store), and vulnerability scanning.
* Monitor and optimize AWS resource utilization and cloud spending without compromising performance.
* Troubleshoot production infrastructure issues, perform root cause analysis, and maintain clear system documentation.

**Required Qualifications**

* Proven experience as a DevOps Engineer, Cloud Engineer, or Site Reliability Engineer with deep hands-on expertise in **AWS**.
* Strong proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (**Terraform** or **CloudFormation**) and configuration management tools (Ansible, Chef, or Puppet).
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or AWS CodeSuite).
* Solid experience with **Docker** and container orchestration (**ECS** or **EKS/Kubernetes**).
* Strong Linux system administration skills and proficiency in scripting languages (**Bash, Python, or Go**).
* Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (VPC, subnets, security groups, VPN, DNS, SSL/TLS, load balancing) and cloud security best practices.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and English communication skills for direct collaboration with global teams.

**Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)**

* AWS Certifications (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional, or SysOps Administrator).
* Experience supporting PHP, Node.js, or Python web applications and managing relational databases (RDS MySQL/PostgreSQL) and caching layers (Redis).
* Familiarity with GitOps workflows (ArgoCD, Flux) and service mesh architectures.

Pay: Php70,000.00 - Php90,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Additional leave
* Opportunities for promotion
* Pay raise
* Promotion to permanent employee
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* How many years of hands-on experience do you have working in a DevOps or Cloud Engineer role specifically managing AWS environments? (Answer with a number)
* Have you provisioned and managed production AWS infrastructure using Terraform, CloudFormation, or AWS CDK? (Yes/No — if Yes, list your primary IaC tool(s) and briefly describe what you automated in 1–2 sentences)
* Have you deployed and managed containerized applications in production using Docker with Amazon ECS or EKS (Kubernetes)? (Yes/No — if Yes, briefly describe your container setup and scaling approach in 1–2 sentences)
* Have you built and maintained end-to-end automated CI/CD pipelines from scratch? (Yes/No — if Yes, list the CI/CD tools you used, such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or AWS CodePipeline, in 1–2 sentences)
* Do you hold any active AWS certifications, and have you configured production monitoring/alerting and IAM security policies? (Yes/No — if Yes, list your certifications and monitoring tools, such as CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog, in 1–2 sentences)

Language:

* English (Required)
* Tagalog (Required)

Work Location: Remote
